title: 第453章 因为他要杀我的朋友第452章 必须给半仙丹
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：分手后，我聘上女同学妈妈小司机第一卷：默认第453章因为他要杀我的朋友（..la）与此同时，别墅门前。
纳兰秋水眉眼弯弯，满心欢喜地走到陈阳面前，将来之不易的半仙品丹药递了过去。
陈阳伸手接过丹瓶，简单扫了一眼，淡淡开口：“多谢。”
紧接着他拔开瓶塞，倒出两枚圆润饱满、灵气四溢的半仙品丹药，伸手递向纳兰秋水。
纳兰秋水连忙抬手摆手，温柔推脱：“不用，你自己留着修炼就好，我不需要。”
陈阳没有收回手，从自己的储物戒中取出一个干净的小丹瓶，小心翼翼将两枚丹药装好。
他上前一步，直接递到纳兰秋水手中，语气带着几分不容拒绝的温和：“秋水姐，你不用跟我客气。
我收下八颗已经足够多了，你再推辞，我可要生气了。”
见他态度真诚坚决，纳兰秋水不再推脱，双手接过丹瓶，眼底满是暖意，轻声道谢：“多谢陈少。”
“不用客气。”陈阳微微摇头，神色淡然。
他将剩下的八枚半仙品丹药收好，妥善放进自己的储物戒中，随后目光下意识落回纳兰秋水的脸上。
夜色温柔，暖黄灯光洒下细碎光晕，落在她清丽的脸庞上，衬得她肌肤白皙细腻，五官温婉动人。
她的唇瓣饱满粉嫩，线条柔和，在夜色烘托下格外诱人，让人忍不住想要凑近亲吻。
纳兰秋水完全没有察觉到他眼底一闪而过的异样情愫，认真开口询问：“陈阳，这些丹药，够吗？”
陈阳轻轻摇了摇头：“不够，我还需要更多丹药，越多越好。”
纳兰秋水了然点头，果断说：“行，那我立刻动身去天山找药老，他活了数百年，底蕴深厚，手上应该存有不少高阶丹药。”
“那就辛苦你了。”陈阳轻声说。
“没事。”纳兰秋水笑了笑，“没别的事，我现在就动身赶过去。”
说完，她转身就准备动身离开。
看着她利落转身的背影，陈阳心底莫名涌上一阵不舍，下意识开口喊住她：“秋水姐。”

纳兰秋水脚步一顿，立刻停下身形，转过身温柔看向他：“怎么了？”
陈阳快步上前，伸手轻轻握住她的手掌，将她柔软的小手稳稳捧在掌心。
她的掌心细腻柔软，触感温润，握着格外舒服。
纳兰秋水被他突如其来的举动弄得心头一颤，心跳瞬间不受控制地加快，脸颊悄悄泛起一层淡淡的绯红，身子微微僵硬，却不好意思直接挣脱，只能任由他握着。
陈阳看着她微红的脸颊，轻声叮嘱：“路上注意安全，好好保重自己。”
纳兰秋水轻轻点头，声音温柔细碎：“我知道，你也是。”
两人静静对视几秒，夜色静谧，氛围温柔。
陈阳这才缓缓松开她的手。
纳兰秋水对着他浅浅一笑，转身快步离去，纤细的身影渐渐消失在夜色长路尽头。
确认她彻底走远、身影完全消失后，陈阳才再次抬手取出那瓶装着八枚半仙品强体丹的玉瓶，看着瓶中灵气充盈的丹药，心底满是欣喜。

Nalan Qiushui's eyebrows were crescent, and she walked up to Chen Yang happily, and handed over the hard-earned semi-immortal elixir.
Chen Yang reached out to take the elixir bottle, glanced at it briefly, and said calmly: "Thank you."
Then he uncorked the bottle, poured out two semi-immortal elixirs that were round, plump and full of spiritual energy, and handed them to Nalan Qiushui.
Nalan Qiu Shui quickly raised his hand and waved it off gently, "No, just keep it for yourself and practice. I don't need it."
Chen Yang did not take back his hand, took out a clean small pill bottle from his storage ring, and carefully packed the two pills.
He took a step forward and handed it directly into Nalan Qiu's hand, with a gentle tone that could not be refused: "Sister Qiu Shui, you don't have to be polite to me.
Eight pills are enough for me to accept. If you refuse again, I will be angry. "
Seeing his sincere and resolute attitude, Nalan Qiushui no longer resisted, and took the elixir bottle with both hands. His eyes were full of warmth, and he thanked softly: "Thank you, Mr. Chen."
"You're welcome." Chen Yang shook his head slightly, his expression indifferent.
He put away the remaining eight semi-immortal elixirs and put them properly into his storage ring, and then his eyes subconsciously fell back on Nalan Qiushui's face.
The night was gentle, and the warm yellow light cast a fine halo of light, which fell on her beautiful face, making her skin white and delicate, and her facial features gentle and moving.
Her lips were plump and pink, with soft lines. They were particularly attractive against the backdrop of the night, making people want to get closer and kiss her.
Nalan Qiushui was completely unaware of the strange emotion flashing through his eyes, and asked seriously: "Chen Yang, are these pills enough?"
Chen Yang shook his head gently: "It's not enough. I need more pills. The more, the better."
Nalan Qiu Shui nodded in understanding and said decisively: "Okay, then I will immediately set off to Tianshan to find Yao Lao. He has lived for hundreds of years and has a profound knowledge. He should have many high-level elixirs in his hand."
"Then thank you for the hard work." Chen Yang said softly.
"It's okay." Nalan Qiushui smiled, "Nothing else, I'll leave now."
After saying that, she turned around and prepared to leave.
Looking at her sharply turned back, Chen Yang felt an inexplicable reluctance in his heart, and subconsciously called her out: "Sister Qiu Shui."
Nalan Qiushui paused, stopped immediately, turned around and looked at him gently: "What's wrong?"
Chen Yang stepped forward quickly, reached out and gently held her hand, holding her soft little hand firmly in his palm.
Her palms are delicate and soft, warm to the touch, and extremely comfortable to hold.
Nalan Qiu Shui's heart trembled at his sudden move, her heartbeat accelerated uncontrollably, her cheeks quietly turned a faint blush, her body stiffened slightly, but she was too embarrassed to break away directly, so she could only let him hold her.
Chen Yang looked at her reddish cheeks and whispered: "Be safe on the road and take care of yourself."
Nalan Qiu Shui nodded gently, her voice gentle and delicate: "I know, you do too."
The two looked at each other quietly for a few seconds, the night was quiet and the atmosphere was gentle.
Chen Yang slowly let go of her hand.
Nalan Qiushui smiled lightly at him, turned around and left quickly, her slender figure gradually disappearing at the end of the long road in the night.
After confirming that she was completely gone and her figure had completely disappeared, Chen Yang raised his hand again and took out the jade bottle containing eight semi-immortal grade body-strengthening pills. He looked at the spiritual energy-filled pills in the bottle, and his heart was full of joy.
